jobs.description: Employer: Skyworks Solutions, Inc. Expires: 09/25/2026 Job Title: RFIC Design Summer InternIf you are looking for a challenging and exciting career in the world of technology, then look no further. Skyworks is an innovator of high-performance analog semiconductors whose solutions are powering the wireless networking revolution. Through our broad technology expertise and one of the most extensive product portfolios in the industry, we are Connecting Everyone and Everything, All the Time. At Skyworks, you will find a fast-paced environment with a strong focus on global collaboration, minimal layers of management, and the freedom to make meaningful contributions in a setting that encourages creative thinking. We are excited about the opportunity to work with you and glad you want to be part of a team of talented individuals who together are changing the way the world communicates.Requisition ID: 78242 DescriptionJoin the Skyworks San Jose Design Center in developing high-performance silicon RFIC solutions for next-generation mobile applications. This internship offers hands-on experience in silicon RFIC design while working closely with experienced engineers in a collaborative team environment.The intern will contribute to the development of RF front-end integrated circuits from initial concept through production. The work will focus on transistor-level circuit design, simulation, layout, and laboratory evaluation of high-performance RF front-end circuits. The intern will also document results and present technical work to colleagues and stakeholders.Located in Silicon Valley near major customers, the San Jose Design Center provides access to highly integrated semiconductor, module, and embedded RF circuit design, an in-house prototype assembly laboratory, and a world-class RF characterization laboratory. This is an excellent opportunity to strengthen technical skills, expand a professional network, and prepare for a career in RFIC design.Responsibilities• Work with a mentor and design team to combine silicon RFIC design with RF and microwave electromagnetic simulation for high-performance RF switches, low-noise amplifiers, and other RF front-end components.• Participate in product development activities, including product definition, architecture, system analysis, transistor-level circuit design, layout or layout supervision, top-level simulation, laboratory debugging, and production test support.Required Experience and Skills• Currently enrolled in an Electrical Engineering (or related) BS or MS programs• In-person Summer internship beginning May/June 2027 (3 months) at the San Jose site• Familiarity with transistor-level design concepts for silicon RFIC and analog circuits.• Understanding of RF active-circuit requirements and design concepts, including noise, linearity, bandwidth, and small-signal and large-signal behavior.• Understanding of microwave and RF fundamentals, including S-parameters, Smith charts, matching networks, noise figure, and transmission lines.• Experience using time-domain and frequency-domain circuit and electromagnetic simulation tools, such as Cadence Spectre and EMX, Keysight ADS and Momentum, or Ansys HFSS.Desired Experience and Skills• Experience with on-chip passive circuit design; chip tapeout experience is a strong plus.• Experience with RF test equipment, including network analyzers, spectrum analyzers, DC power supplies, and RF probes. Skyworks is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. completion.Examples of Internship ProjectsDepending on current company priorities and the student's skills, an intern could be asked to:Build a dashboard that combines operational and financial systems.Analyze business data using SQL, Excel, Power BI, or Python and present the findings.Help develop an AI-enabled feature for an existing VGI application.Test a new customer-facing application management reports, and understand how technology investments contribute to organizational performance.This provides an opportunity for students to connect technical skills with fundamental business concepts such as revenue, expense, profitability, productivity, return on investment, resource allocation, budgeting, and data-driven decision-making.Desired Academic BackgroundThe internship is appropriate for students pursuing a bachelor's degree in areas such as:Computer ScienceComputer Information SystemsManagement Information SystemsData AnalyticsCybersecurityBusiness AnalyticsFinance or Accounting with strong technology/data skillsOther related technology or business disciplinesA completed degree is not required for internship candidates.Desired Technical SkillsCandidates should have coursework, experience, or a strong interest in several of the following:PythonSQLJavaScript or comparable programming languagesMicrosoft ExcelPower BI or other business-intelligence toolsDatabasesREST APIs and system integrationsWeb application developmentArtificial intelligence and generative AISource controlApplication testingTechnical documentationExperience with technologies such as React, Node.js, .NET, cloud platforms, Docker, GitHub, and CI/CD is beneficial but not required for every internship assignment.Professional SkillsSuccessful interns should demonstrate:Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.Curiosity and willingness to learn new technologies.Good written and verbal communication.Organization and attention to detail.Ability to manage assigned jobs.feedName: Andrew J. Anagnost College of Engineering and Computer Science
jobs.title: Business Analyst Intern at Right Click
jobs.description: Employer: Right Click Expires: 09/27/2026 Consulting is finally reaching small and medium businesses.Strategy consulting has long had a price floor. A partner sold the work, and a pyramid of analysts did the research, the document review, the benchmarking, the models, the first drafts. That pyramid is roughly why serious advisory work tended to start around $100,000, which left the small and mid-sized businesses that make up most of the economy largely outside the market.That's starting to change. Analytical work that would have taken weeks can now often be done by a agile team with a good AI workflow. It starts to look possible to deliver real advisory work to a 60-person manufacturer in Orange County at a price they'd actually pay.We're a managed IT and cybersecurity firm working with clients across aerospace, defense, healthcare, and professional services in Southern California. We already have the relationships, and we have an unusual amount of data — years of ticket history, systems inventory, security posture, and software spend for every client we serve. It's close to the raw material an outside consultant would spend weeks trying to assemble. We're building a consulting practice that turns that operational data into recommendations clients can act on.What you'd actually doYou'd take a live client, pull their operational data, and look for the story in it — where money is leaking, which systems have quietly become shelfware, what's generating the same ticket forty times a month, where they might be exposed on compliance. Then you'd build the analysis and write up the recommendation.The intent is that your work, with your name on it, shapes what we end up advising a client to do, rather than arriving as a research task with the interesting part already decided.What you leave withA portfolio of real client work, which not many interns get. Real fluency in AI-assisted analysis — a competence a lot of firms are hiring for and most programs haven't caught up to yet. And some sense of what it looks like to build a business model from the inside, which is a different education than a semester of cases about someone else's.We're looking forA business, finance, economics, or analytics student who's curious about how companies actually run, reasonably comfortable with messy data and Excel, and a clear writer. It helps if you've already been using Claude or similar AI tools on your own coursework and have some feel for where they're genuinely useful and where they aren't. More than any of that, we're looking for someone who wants to go find the answer rather than wait to be handed the question.ApplySend a résumé and a short note — three or four sentences on a business problem you've found interesting lately — to [careers@rclick.com].Right Click is an equal opportunity employer.Benefits:401(k)401(k) matchingDental insuranceEmployee assistance programFlexible spending accountHealth insurancePaid time offProfessional development assistanceRetirement planVision insuranceWork Location: In person

Apply through the Grant Thornton Job portal at www.grantthornton.com/campuscareers (including resume and transcript) Who is Grant Thornton? At Grant Thornton, we believe in making business more personal and building trust into every result – for our clients and you. Here, we go beyond your expectations of a career in professional services by offering a career path with more: more opportunity, more flexibility, and more support. It’s what makes us different, and we think being different makes us better. In the U.S., Grant Thornton delivers professional services through two specialized entities: Grant Thornton LLP, a licensed, certified public accounting (CPA) firm that provides audit and assurance services ― and Grant Thornton Advisors LLC (not a licensed CPA firm), which exclusively provides non-attest offerings, including tax and advisory services. In 2025, Grant Thornton formed a multinational, multidisciplinary platform with Grant Thornton Ireland. The platform offers a premier Trans-Atlantic advisory and tax practice, as well as independent American and Irish audit practices. With $2.7 billion in revenues and more than 50 offices spanning the U.S., Ireland and other territories, the platform delivers a singular client experience that includes enhanced solutions and capabilities, backed by powerful technologies and a roster of 12,000 quality-driven professionals enjoying exceptional career-growth opportunities and a distinctive cross-border culture. Grant Thornton is part of the Grant Thornton International Limited network, which provides access to its member firms in more than 150 global markets. About Advisory Services Grant Thornton’s Advisory professionals are progressive thinkers who create, protect, and transform value today, so our clients have the opportunity to thrive and grow. Our advisory practice creates holistic solutions delivered by innovative, curious professionals who bring technical depth and industry insight to our clients. What is Risk Advisory? Within our Cyber & Risk Solution Family, Risk Advisory helps organizations grow with confidence by delivering agile, technology-enabled risk services that strengthen resilience, improve business performance, and unlock new opportunities. We work with complex organizations to assess, transform, and operate internal controls, risk management, compliance and Internal Audit activities, programs, and functions. POSITION SUMMARY: Risk Advisory Interns are responsible for working on client engagements, including: Assessing business and information technology processes and system internal controls. Executing enterprise, operational, information technology and third-party risk management and compliance programs. Executing internal audit plans, including information technology internal audits. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: Understand, document, and assess various client operations, processes, systems, controls, and programs, and identify opportunities for improvement Assist with conducting risk assessments to inform enterprise risk, operational risk and third-party risk management projects, programs and internal audit plans. Assess transactions, processes, systems, and controls to support assessments, Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) and other regulatory compliance, and internal audit projects. Obtain and analyze data, identify trends, and visualize results using commercially available analytics solutions. Leverage analytics, automation, artificial intelligence (AI), and other technology aids to advance your understanding, drive throughput on project objectives, and deliver client services efficiently and effectively. Establish and maintain good working relationships with team members and clients, and work effectively with client personnel at all levels. Collaborate closely with team members and clients to understand project approach, identify and manage project risks, execute assigned project responsibilities, and recommend opportunities to improve processes, internal controls, risk management, and compliance. Obtain an understanding of relevant industry trends, business objectives, operations, processes, systems, etc. applicable to assigned client projects Assist with business development activities including conducting research, contributing to proposals, and other activities as appropriate. Participate in Firm activities such as recruiting, training, officewide activities, and more. Other duties as assigned. Why become a Risk Advisory Intern? A Risk Advisory Intern will gain exposure to various industries, business processes, operations, systems and controls as an integral member of project delivery teams. As a Risk Advisory Intern, you will be executing high quality Risk Advisory projects and services under the supervision of experienced Risk Advisory team members. You will be responsible for efficiently managing your workload to budget and timeline. What are we looking for in an Intern? We are seeking self-starters and analytical thinkers who are curious, enjoy working in a collaborative, performance-driven environment, and want to help our clients solve complex problems using the latest technology and data-enabled methods. Risk Advisory Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Technology, MIS or related field. Desire to pursue CPA, PMP, CISA, CIA, CISSP, CAMS, CISM, or other relevant license/certification preferred. Overall GPA of 3.0/4.0. Available to travel at least 25% as required. Ability to work additional hours as needed. Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future. No visa sponsorship is available for this position. Skill Requirements Ability to learn, understand and work across various industries and functional areas within an organization. Excellent analytical, communication (written and verbal), presentation, and interpersonal skills. Strong technical aptitude, complex analysis, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills. Effective project and time management skills. Ability to work in a rapidly growing, fast-paced, interactive, performance-driven team environment. Enthusiasm to learn through a combination of structured, on-the-job and self-directed training. Ability to work efficiently and effectively independently and in a team environment. Desire to pursue applicable professional license/certification as outlined above. TRAINING: Grant Thornton LLP provides both local and national training programs related to an individual’s job responsibilities. We are committed to ongoing professional development, and we encourage individuals to attend outside training seminars. A strong sense of ownership over one’s own training and development is key to success in this role. The team you’re about to join is ready to help you thrive. Here’s how: Whether it’s your work location, weekly schedule or flex time off, we empower you with the options to work in the way that best serves your clients and your life. Consistent with the firm’s hybrid work model, this position will require in-person attendance at least three days per week, either at a GT office or client site. Here, you are supported to prioritize your overall well-being through work-life integration options that work best for you and those in your household. We understand that your needs, responsibilities and experiences are different — and we think that’s a good thing. That’s why we support you with personalized and comprehensive benefits that recognize and empower all the identities, roles and aspirations that make you, well, you. See how at www.gt.com/careers. When it comes to inclusion, we are committed to doing more than checking boxes. Explore all the ways we’re taking action for diversity, equity & inclusion at www.gt.com/careers. Here’s what you can expect next: If you apply and are selected to interview, a Grant Thornton team member will reach out to you to schedule a time to connect. We encourage you to also check out other roles that may be a good fit for you or get to know us a little bit better at www.gt.com/careers. Benefits: We understand that your needs, responsibilities and experiences are different, and we think that’s a good thing. That’s why we support you with personalized and comprehensive benefits that recognize and empower all the identities, roles and aspirations that make you, well, you. For an overview of our benefit offerings, please visit: https://www.grantthornton.com/careers/rewards-and-benefits. Benefits for internship positions: Grant Thornton interns are eligible to participate in the firm’s medical, dental and vision insurance programs and the firm’s employee assistance program. Interns also receive a minimum of 72 hours of paid sick leave, and are paid for firm holidays that fall within their internship period. Benefits for seasonal employee positions: Grant Thornton seasonal employees are eligible to participate in the firm’s medical, dental and vision insurance programs and the firm’s employee assistance program. Seasonal employees may also be eligible to participate in the firm’s 401(k) savings plan and employee retirement plan in accordance with applicable plan terms and eligibility requirements. Seasonal employees receive a minimum of 72 hours of paid sick leave. Grant Thornton employees may be eligible for a discretionary, annual bonus based on individual and firm performance, subject to the terms, conditions and eligibility criteria of the applicable bonus plan or program. Interns and seasonal employees are not eligible for bonus compensation. Additional Details: It is the policy of Grant Thornton to promote equal employment opportunities. All personnel decisions (including, but not limited to, recruiting, hiring, training, working conditions, promotion, transfer, compensation, benefits, evaluations, and termination) are made without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, marital or civil union status, pregnancy or pregnancy-related condition, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship status, veteran status, disability, handicap, genetic predisposition or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. Consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state and local laws, it is the policy of Grant Thornton to provide reasonable accommodation when requested by a qualified applicant or employee with a disability, unless such accommodation would cause an undue hardship. The policy regarding requests for reasonable accommodation applies to all aspects of employment, including the application process. To make an accommodation request, please contact HR@us.gt.com. For Los Angeles Applicants only: We will consider for employment all qualified Applicants, including those with Criminal Histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance. The pay rate for this position in the firm’s Los Angeles, CA office is $40 per hour.

jobs.title: Project Engineer Intern at Murray Company
jobs.description: Employer: Murray Company Expires: 09/27/2026 Come grow with us...At Murray Company, how we operate is defined by shared values that are 100 years in the making - Safety, Quality, Honesty, Hard Work and Pride of Ownership. These values have led to our company consistently being in the top 15% on ENRs Best Specialty Contractor’s list. Bring your enthusiasm and unique perspective to Murray Company where you will have the opportunity to grow with us professionally, personally, and financially. Join a team that cares about helping you thrive and succeed. You'll work alongside talented colleagues while establishing lifelong friendships and making a difference in our company and the specialty contracting community. Position SummaryAre you a current student looking to expand your knowledge and business acumen with practical hands-on experience and training opportunities? Start your career with a summer internship at Murray Company, - one of the nation’s Top 20 Mechanical Contractors and a leader in innovation and excellence. As an intern in our Operations group reporting to our talented project managers, you will work alongside our top-notch teams in our pre-construction, fabrication and field installation functions. This internship offers the opportunity to gain hands-on Project Management experience in support of mechanical projects of various sizes and specialties (plumbing, HVAC, process piping, and industrial). Location: Boise, ID, with anticipated travel to designated project sites in and around the greater Boise metropolitan areas. Compensation: $23.00 per hour Internship Program Schedule & HoursDuration: 40 hours per week for 10-12 consecutive weeks, beginning as early as May 2027.Typical working hours are Monday to Friday, 7 am - 4 pm (subject to change depending on local project requirements).Program participants must be available to work within the required schedule for the duration of the internship. Key ResponsibilitiesAssist in planning, scheduling, and coordinating mechanical projects.Provide support for reviewing designs, drawings, and specifications.Assist with managing project documentation, including submittals, RFIs, change orders, and reports.Participate in site visits to monitor progress and ensure compliance with specifications.Support the preparation of cost estimates and budgets.Aid in the implementation of quality control measures.Facilitate communication among project teams, subcontractors, suppliers, and clients.Assist with safety protocol implementation and compliance. QualificationsRequiredMust be currently enrolled in an accredited university program and actively pursuing a degree in Construction Management, Mechanical Engineering or related field.Proficiency in computer programs such as Microsoft Office Products (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, etc.).Demonstrated ability to take initiative and interact effectively in a team environment.Availability to work 40 hours per week within the required schedule for the duration of the internship (typically 10 weeks).PreferredStrong organizational skills.Ability to multi-task and work in a fast-paced environment.Experience with construction software such as Revit, Navisworks, Bluebeam, Procore, ACC Build or other related programs. Physical RequirementsProlonged periods of sitting at a desk.Must be able to lift to 15 pounds at times.Must have sufficient visual acuity to view and interpret detailed construction drawings on computer screens and on paper.Must be able to traverse uneven surfaces on project sites and climb stairs to access project site temporary offices. Contingent EmploymentOffers of employment are contingent upon successful completion of the Company’s required pre-employment drug screening process. Murray Company is a federal contractor and complies with all applicable federal laws and regulations regarding controlled substances. Work AuthorizationMurray Company is not sponsoring employment-based visas at this time. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on an ongoing, permanent basis without the need for current or future visa sponsorship.

jobs.title: Robotics Operations Intern at Civ Robotics
jobs.description: Employer: Civ Robotics Expires: 09/27/2026 Robotics Operations Intern — Part-TimeLocation: San Francisco, CA — On-siteDepartment: OperationsEmployment Type: Part-Time InternshipAbout Civ RoboticsCiv Robotics is on a mission to automate repetitive tasks within the $3 trillion infrastructure construction industry. We build autonomous robotic solutions that help construction teams work faster, safer, and more efficiently.With more than 100 robots deployed on construction sites around the world, our team works at the intersection of robotics, hardware, software, and real-world field operations.About the RoleWe’re looking for a part-time Robotics Operations Intern to join our team in San Francisco and support the day-to-day operations behind our growing robot fleet.This is a highly hands-on role. You’ll work alongside our Robotics Operations and Applications team to help prepare robots and equipment for customer deployments, organize outgoing shipments, receive and process incoming equipment, maintain our inventory and workspace, and make sure our robots and accessories are ready when and where they’re needed.This role is ideal for a current engineering student looking to gain practical experience with real robotic systems while continuing their studies. You’ll get an inside look at what it takes to operate and support a fleet of robots being used on active construction sites around the world.What You’ll DoPrepare robots, accessories, tools, and equipment for customer deployments and shipmentsPack, organize, label, and coordinate outgoing robot shipmentsReceive, unpack, inspect, and organize incoming and returned equipmentHelp prepare robots for upcoming deployments, demos, and field operationsPerform basic robot setup, cleaning, charging, inspection, and readiness checksMaintain organized inventory of robots, accessories, spare parts, tools, and shipping materialsTrack equipment moving in and out of the office and help ensure everything is accounted forAssist with basic robot testing, troubleshooting, and operational tasksHelp keep our robotics workspace organized and deployment-readyJump in on other hands-on operational projects as neededWhat We’re Looking ForCurrently pursuing a degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or another related technical fieldInterest in robotics, hardware, automation, or electromechanical systemsComfortable working hands-on with physical equipment, tools, and robotic hardwareHighly organized and detail-orientedDependable and comfortable taking ownership of recurring operational tasksWilling to learn and jump in wherever the team needs supportComfortable working in a fast-moving startup environmentAble to safely lift and move equipment as required for shipping and operational preparationAvailable to work part-time from our San Francisco office during the academic yearNice to HaveHands-on experience with robotics, electronics, mechanical systems, or hardwareExperience with tools, assembly, repairs, fabrication, or technical projectsParticipation in a university robotics team, Formula SAE, FIRST Robotics, makerspace, or similar hands-on engineering activitiesFamiliarity with Linux, ROS/ROS2, electronics, or basic scriptingExperience with shipping, inventory, lab, warehouse, or equipment-management processesWhat You’ll GainThis isn’t a desk-only internship. You’ll work directly with real robots and alongside the team responsible for getting them ready for customers and deployments.You’ll gain practical exposure to robotics operations, robot hardware, deployment preparation, fleet and equipment management, testing, troubleshooting, and the day-to-day realities of working at a fast-growing robotics startup.As you become familiar with our robots and systems, there may also be opportunities to take on more technical projects and responsibilities.

jobs.title: Coursicle Software Engineer Internship – NYC Summer 2027 at Coursicle
jobs.description: Employer: Coursicle Expires: 09/28/2026 Over 2 million college students use Coursicle to stay on top of their classes and homework.Coursicle is your all-in-one academic planner:Sync and color-code assignments from Canvas, Blackboard, Brightspace (D2L), Moodle, and moreGet reminders for upcoming classes, assignments, quizzes, projects, and examsGet notified when classes have open seatsRead reviews of their professorsBuild schedules and create backup schedules for registrationFor the first time since our founding, Coursicle is expanding beyond course registration. Students can now sync and color-code homework from any system, see friends’ schedules in real-time, and chat anonymously with classmates. With these features and new ones you'll help us implement, we’re hoping students will begin to rely on Coursicle every day of the semester. Click here for a 60 second demo of Coursicle’s features.YouWe don't care about what languages you know or frameworks you have experience in. Our philosophy has always been to hire great people and teach them what they need to know (footnote 1). And although development is the role's focus, since we're a very small team you'll have the opportunity to learn about other aspects of the business as well (software, business, marketing, etc.).UsCompany:700,000 usersRunning entirely on revenueSmall team (6 full-time, 3 part-time)Click here to check out our Instagram to get a sense for the team.Missions:Mental health: we've seen first-hand the stigma that's held toward mental illness (read our CEO's essay about his struggle with anxiety and depression). It's all too common to feel isolated and overwhelmed in college. Coursicle began as a way to reduce the anxiety of course registration and we're continuing that effort by helping students feel more in control of their academic lives.Wealth disparity: we don't want to make the rich richer, so we don't take investment and we don't optimize for profit. We want to show the world that money can't continue to be the end goal anymore and you can be successful without trying to squeeze every cent out of people.Footnotes: In case you want to see our tech stack anyway, here you go.

Here, you’ll be part of a company that values and champions new ways of thinking, work with dynamic individuals, and acquire new skills and experiences that will propel your career to new heights. Making animals’ lives better makes life better – join our team today! Interns will have exposure to many career paths and diverse subject matter experts as many projects have network-wide impact. jobs.description: Employer: Federal Reserve Board Expires: 09/28/2026 SummaryThe Federal Reserve Board (Board) provides students opportunities for career success. The Board’s Internship program is designed to provide valuable work experience for graduate students considering careers including, but not limited to, economics, finance and accounting, information systems, and data analysis. The Board believes that by combining academic endeavors with project-related work experience, qualified and capable college students can gain the practical knowledge need in a competitive global job market. Internships are paid positions with salaries commensurate with credit hours; internships may be in-person, remote or hybrid, depending on the needs of the team. Employment in the Board’s internship program is granted to U.S. citizens. Applicants must be currently enrolled in a graduate degree program at an accredited university and returning to continue studies after the internship. Interns have access to a wide range of training programs and events for professional development purposes.Qualifications - ExternalAbout Stress Testing National Program - Operations:The Federal Reserve’s Stress Testing Program assesses whether U.S. bank holding companies (BHCs), covered savings and loan holding companies (SLHCs), and intermediate holding companies of foreign banking organizations (IHCs) with $100 billion or more in assets (together, referred to as “large banks”) are sufficiently capitalized to absorb losses and continue lending to households and businesses under stressful conditions. The stress tests evaluate the resilience of large banks by estimating their losses, revenues, expenses and resulting capital levels - which provide a cushion against losses - under hypothetical recession scenarios into the future.The Stress Testing Operations area includes both Program Management and Technology teams. Together, these teams are responsible for managing the nexus between the Program’s staff, the full scope of assigned work, and accessibility of necessary technology and data. Members of both teams manage cross-functional projects and high-priority initiatives and oversee day-to-day activities to ensure that the Program can meet critical milestones and achieve strategic objectives. US Citizenship is required for all Board internships and applicants must be current students, graduating from their program August 2027 or later.

jobs.title: Business Development Research Intern at NatureServe
jobs.description: Employer: NatureServe Expires: 09/30/2026 Business Development ​Research Intern About NatureServeFor 50 years, NatureServe has been the authoritative source for biodiversity data throughout North America. With an international network of over 60 Natural Heritage Programs and Conservation Data Centers across the United States and Canada (“the Network”), NatureServe is the leading source of information on rare and endangered species and the ecosystems on which North American species depend. To protect threatened biodiversity, NatureServe works with over 1,000 conservation scientists to collect, aggregate, and standardize biodiversity statistics, providing comprehensive data to the public for strategic conservation efforts. NatureServe and its network programs develop and manage the most comprehensive data for over 100,000 species and ecosystems, answering fundamental questions about what the critical elements of biodiversity are, where they are found, and how they are doing. About the role​​NatureServe is seeking a Business Development Research Intern to support the growth of our biodiversity data business. You’ll work directly with the Director of Biodiversity Data Sales to research prospective companies, understand how they are organized, and identify the right decisionmakers for outreach. This is a part-time, paid internship, well suited to a graduate student or recent graduate with an interest in conservation, biodiversity, or environmental science, combined with research or business-development experience. ​The internship offers hands-one experience in business development and market research within the growing biodiversity, environmental, and geospatial data sector. You’ll gain exposure to how companies use environmental data in real-world decisions, while developing practical research skills and familiarity with the organizations, technologies, and career paths shaping this field.​On a recurring (approximately weekly) basis, you'll receive a set of target companies and guidance on the types of roles or business units we want to reach. Your research will help us understand who the right people are and how best to approach each organization. For each company, you will:​Review the company's website and public materials to understand its structure, identifying the correct business unit for large or complex organizations.​Identify 2–3 high-quality contacts per company who closely match the target roles provided, prioritizing people with direct responsibility for the relevant product, service line, or purchasing decision.​Verify each contact's current employment, title, and business unit using LinkedIn and other public sources.​Identify and verify business email addresses using verification tools, clearly flagging anything that can't be verified.​Compile findings into a shared tracker: full name, title, business unit, email, verification status, LinkedIn profile, and notes.​Flag companies where no suitable contact can be identified, rather than guessing or submitting unverified information.​Join a regular (approximately weekly) check-in to review completed lists, ask questions, and calibrate the approach as target roles evolve.​Accuracy and relevance are the priorities throughout. The goal is to minimize bounced emails and outreach to the wrong people, not to maximize volume. Contacts should be independently verified using reliable sources such as company websites, LinkedIn, and an email verification tool rather than relying on AI-generated contact information. What you'll doKey responsibilities for the Business Development Research Intern include but are not limited to:Research and identify potential corporate, government, and nonprofit partners that align with NatureServe's mission and strategic priorities Find and verify accurate contact information including names, titles, emails, and organizational structure for target leadsEnter and maintain lead and contact information in Salesforce and shared research trackersHelp segment leads by outreach priority (sector, geography, funding potential, etc.)Flag outdated or inaccurate data for correctionSupport the business development and sales team by preparing outreach lists and background materialsDig into background research on prospective partners ahead of outreach or meetingsTrack outreach activity and results to help the team report on lead generation progressProvide light administrative support on partnership tracking (e.g., updating pipeline status)Share research findings clearly with the team so they can act on itOther duties as assigned QualificationsRequired Skills & Experience:​​Strong research and information-gathering skills​Comfortable digging through LinkedIn, company websites, and public sources to find accurate contacts​High attention to detail and accuracy, especially in data entry​Strong written communication skills​Self-motivated and able to manage your own time in a remote role​Comfortable with Microsoft Office/Google Workspace; willing to learn CRM or database tools (training provided)​Interest in biodiversity, environmental data, GIS, sustainability or related fields.Preferred Certifications, Training, or Education:Current undergraduate or graduate student, or recent graduate, in environmental science. data, GIS, sustainability, business, or related field. Curiosity about how data and technology are used to solve environmental problems is strongly preferred. Physical Demands and Work EnvironmentThe physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the functions.Work Conditions:% Time Remote: ​100%​Travel Required: ​No​On-Call Requirement: ​No​ Physical RequirementsSitting​​Typing / Computer UseRepetitive Motion Reasonable AccommodationsNatureServe is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact Human Resources at [insert email/phone] to request an accommodation.The pay range for this role is $25 USD per hour (Remote)

recent graduates also consideredCoursework, projects, or prior experience related to information security, risk, compliance, or IT is preferredInterest in pursuing security or compliance certifications (e.g., CompTIA Security+, ISACA CRISC, or similar) is a plusDemonstrated KnowledgeFamiliarity with basic information security, risk, and compliance conceptsGeneral awareness of data privacy and financial regulations such as GLBA, GDPR, CCPA and CPRA is a plusProficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook); exposure to collaboration and GRC tools is a plusStrong attention to detail; high level of honesty and integrityAbility to handle multiple tasks simultaneously, take initiative and be proactiveWillingness to learn, ask questions, and follow documented processesCommunication SkillsAbility to communicate clearly and professionally with staff across the organization; willingness to document processes and develop written materials that draw from information in the field, whether working independently or as part of a teamPhysical Requirements Ability to sit and stand; answer calls; operate a computer; interact with internal staff and the public on the phone; travel to designated offices; lift up to 20 lbs. jobs.feedName: Andrew J. Anagnost College of Engineering and Computer Science
jobs.title: Electrical Engineer Intern at Affiliated Engineers, Inc.
jobs.description: Employer: Affiliated Engineers, Inc. Expires: 10/01/2026 Join a Team Where Engineering Excellence Drives Opportunity At Affiliated Engineers, Inc. (AEI), we bring together expertise and innovation to solve the most complex challenges. Since 1978, we’ve supported mission-driven organizations in designing systems and environments that advance society and improve lives. Today, with more than 900 professionals across 22 offices, we help shape the future of healthcare, science and technology, energy, education, and other vital sectors. From elevating patient care in Mayo Clinic’s world-class hospitals to enabling discovery in high-containment laboratories for U.S. agencies and driving environmental progress with Microsoft’s renowned Thermal Energy Center, our work enriches the human experience, safeguards the environment, and pushes the boundaries of possibility. AEI consistently earns national recognition from leading industry publications, including Building Design+Construction, Engineering News-Record, and Consulting-Specifying Engineer, with distinctions such as being named the #1 Laboratory Engineering Firm in the nation and receiving multiple Best of the Best Project awards, underscoring the lasting legacy of our work. At AEI, you’ll join a collaborative community where your expertise fuels innovation, your ideas drive progress, and your work helps shape a brighter future. As an Electrical Engineer Intern in our Washington, D.C. office, you will help us empower our clients to achieve energy-efficient building solutions, save global environments, and create a better, greener future for all. Why we need you:In this role, you will have the opportunity to approach design in unconventional ways, apply your knowledge while working on significant and complex projects, work alongside professionals known for advanced engineering solutions, observe how a successful engineering firm operates, establish ties that could solidify your professional future, and learn within a friendly, supportive environment. Expertise of our most successful Electrical Engineer Intern:Enrollment in Electrical or Architectural Engineering program from ABET accredited school.Completed 3 years of coursework or have a junior standing.Minimum GPA of 2.5.Leadership involvement in extracurricular activities/student organizations. Effective skills to help you flourish:Strong spoken and written communications skills.Excellent organization and time management skills.Quick technical comprehension and motivation focused on client outcomes.Able to effectively prioritize multiple tasks.Effective working individually and within team environments. When you work here, you can expect:A flexible, collaborative environment where your well-being matters—because your best work happens when you’re supported.Real opportunities to grow—through mentorship, professional development programs, and exposure to high-impact projects across disciplines.To collaborate with inspiring teammates who challenge the status quo, foster innovation, and pave the way for future leaders.A benefits package that offers health, dental, vision, and retirement, a performance-based year-end bonus, and thoughtful perks tailored to your needs—whether that's a flexible work environment, wellness resources, or community-focused initiatives, we’ll continue to invest in. If this dynamic environment and the chance to contribute to transformative projects resonate with your ambitions, we would love to connect with you. Join us and make an impact!Apply online at https://aeieng.com/about/careers/If you know someone who would thrive in this role, please share this posting with them directly via email or through your LinkedIn network.AEI is proud to be an EEO/AA Employer/Vet/Disabled.

jobs.feedName: Andrew J. Anagnost College of Engineering and Computer Science
jobs.title: Automation Internship - Summer 2027 at Conagra Brands
jobs.description: Employer: Conagra Brands Expires: 10/01/2026 Have a taste for something big? Launch your career at Conagra Brands, one of North America’s leading branded food companies! Our internship program will introduce you to the world of consumer-packaged goods with the goal of cooking up an interest in future career opportunities and allowing you to make an impact in a refuse-to-lose environment. Come work for a company known for iconic brands: Reddi-wip, Slim Jim, Angie’s BOOMCHICKPOP, Swiss Miss and more! What Can You Expect from Your Internship?You will be immersed into Conagra Brands and our GBIS Organization for 11 weeks. Interns support growth, find operational efficiencies and solve complex business problems, enterprise wide. They use the latest technologies to refine and scale our current ecosystem and gain exposure to the critical business processes and applications that drive Conagra’s success in the industry. To enhance your overall understanding of our company, we will provide opportunities to network with peers and leaders to gain experience with the scope of career paths available at Conagra Brands. When: May 24 – August 6, 2027Location(s): Omaha, NESchedule: Interns should expect to work 40 hours/week Why should you become a Conagra intern?Our intern compensation starts at $23/hrWe set you up for success. All interns participate in two days of orientation in Omaha.You’ll receive professional development before and during the internship.Network with and learn from our leaders across the company.Summer Hours. Offices close at 1 p.m. on Friday.You don’t have to stress about getting to your new city or where you’re going to live. Summer relocation and housing is provided by Conagra as needed.Summer Send Off. Come back to Omaha to celebrate and give back to the community. Is this internship right for you?We're looking for someone who wants to be part of promoting the most energized, highest impact culture in the food industry. If you are craving an opportunity to make a difference and be empowered to kick start your professional career in a refuse-to-lose environment, then we want to meet you! We encourage you to discover your potential and we will provide you with unparalleled opportunities to make a difference. Do you have what it takes?You are enrolled in a degree program with at least 1 semester remaining after the internship program concludesAre pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Management Information Systems, or similar majors best suited for this positionYou are willing to relocate to Omaha, NE for the duration of your internship We want you to bring your whole self to work and value diversity and inclusion:Named a Best Place to Work multiple years by Human Rights Campaign’s Corporate Equality Index for LGBTQ+One of the Best Places to Work for Disability Inclusion by The Disability Equality IndexTop company for LatinX talent as named by Latino Leaders MagazineMulti-Year honoree of Civic 50, recognizing the nation’s 50 most civic-minded companiesScholarship provider to Thurgood Marshall and Hispanic Scholarship Foundation Hourly Rate: $20-28 Our Intern BenefitsAs a Conagra intern, you get paid holidays, relocation and housing assistance. During your time with us, you’ll have access to learning and development live sessions, as well as tools like LinkedIn Learning. You will also travel to our Omaha campus for Intern Orientation as well as an End of Summer Celebration.Our Company Conagra Brands is one of North America's leading branded food companies. Guided by an entrepreneurial spirit, our Company combines a rich heritage of making great food with a sharpened focus on innovation. Our portfolio is evolving to satisfy people's changing food preferences. Our iconic brands, such as Birds Eye, Duncan Hines, Healthy Choice, Marie Callender's, Reddi-wip, and Slim Jim, and emerging brands, including Angie's BOOMCHICKAPOP, Duke's, Earth Balance, Gardein, and Frontera, offer choices for every occasion.We pride ourselves on having the most impactful, energized and inclusive culture in the food industry. For more information, visit www.conagrabrands.com. Conagra Brands is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to sex, race, color, religion, ethnic or national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, pregnancy, leave status, disability, veteran status, genetic information and/or any other characteristic or status protected by national, federal, state or local law. Reasonable accommodation may be made upon request.
